review_role: Separately authored review and adversarial controls within this same assisted investigation; not independent scientific replication.
scope: Exact resource-receipt consumer before prospective same-input execution. No inference, new model or dataset acquisition, actual prediction or annotation reads, cleanup, old-owner edits or candidate changes by this role.

qualification.author_integration_scope: 16 custody/gate controls and 5 integration controls. Integration invokes actual byte-identical numerical verify_output on an authored two-tile/two-model70-array packet; only bind_inputs is replaced by an explicit authored fixture context. It does not admit real source images or models.
qualification.author_initial_failure: Initial integration had one missing input_reconstruction fixture field at report assembly; original failure log retained. Fixture corrected before final pass; production acceptance was not weakened.

review_prompted_changes.issue: A worker clock could begin before prelaunch or finish after final observation while individual fields remained within limits.
review_prompted_changes.resolution: Consumer checks common clock origin against completed prelaunch sample and worker finish against final sample; final RSS state is exact.

review_prompted_changes.issue: Audited worker-runtime files alone did not identify the actual consumer interpreter used by numerical reconstruction.
review_prompted_changes.resolution: Consumer process executable and sys.prefix must match the pinned interpreter and venv before numerical library import.

review_prompted_changes.issue: Current log hashes could miss a same-size edit before checking.
review_prompted_changes.resolution: Outer launch record now binds worker_log_sha256 and worker_log_bytes immediately after supervisor exit; consumer checks both and rehashes observations after checking.

review_prompted_changes.issue: The frozen before audit could be named as the after report.
review_prompted_changes.resolution: Destination paths cannot alias frozen inputs/contract; reports require distinct capture paths, aware timestamps in strict order enclosing resource sample wall timestamps.

checked_acceptance: Exact qualified supervisor, worker, numerical checker, capacity and source identities; prospective contract and full required freeze checked before and after.
Outer zero exit/no timeout and command/output identities; returned/retained receipt equivalence; final publication with no pending receipt, no stop and system providers.
Complete sample phase/sequence/PID chronology, missing/error/unknown handling, exact headroom arithmetic, observed peak RSS, maximum gaps/durations and last worker-time semantics.
Current runtime declared-file/RECORD/interpreter hashes and matching before/after reports; exact executing interpreter identity.
Actual unchanged receipt reaches unchanged numerical bind_inputs and verify_output only after resource admission; nested numerical result and wrapper attribution remain distinct.
Exact numerical last raw/admission pointer checks and full tile/model population remain in unchanged checker; no synthetic legacy receipt or assumed empty output.
Observation hashes stable through checking and exact final logical-file inventory accounts for the final journal line and receipt; outer worker-log pin closes prior same-size-edit gap.
limits: Integrity checks do not authenticate a wholly fabricated self-consistent execution history.
The wrapper does not independently run the neural models, perform reference matching or establish a complete-work advantage.
Current declared runtime files are rehashed, but entire unrecorded-file census, excluded bytecode and system libraries are not independently rederived.
Available bytes and allocated output remain sampled APFS observations; no reservation, continuous floor, process-tree containment or crash durability is established.
After-report and resource timestamps are consistency observations, not authenticated time.
This review does not establish current capacity, admit actual detector outputs or authorize reuse of a closed owner.
next_contract: A separately frozen execution must preserve original selected images, models, thresholds, source bindings and600s/3GiB limits.
The outer launcher must emit the exact new schema including worker-log digest/length, freeze digest, stdout/stderr digests and exact command.
Downstream matching must explicitly admit this wrapper composition and its nested numerical result, not substitute the historical checker identity.
